purpose: Select the next late-time observable class from the frozen AeST memory theory response before fitting any new late-time dataset.

frozen_model.eta_response_definition: central tangent response (X(+lambda)-X(-lambda))/(2 lambda), interpreted as dX/deta at eta=0

cosmic_shear_weyl.score: RMS fractional response over the fixed window

linear_galaxy_clustering.score: RMS fractional response over the fixed window

RSD_fsigma8.score: RMS fractional response over the fixed grid

cmb_lensing_weyl_proxy.note: Reported for physical context only. ACT DR6 lensing is already the independently predeclared v0.62 test and is excluded from v0.63 next-target ranking.

selection_rule: Among cosmic_shear_weyl, linear_galaxy_clustering, and RSD_fsigma8, select the observable class with the largest predeclared RMS absolute fractional response per unit eta. This is a response-only ranking, not a forecast signal-to-noise or a claim about an existing anomaly.
anti_tuning: No late-time observational likelihood, bandpower, covariance, residual, anomaly significance, or survey-specific result is inspected in v0.63 before the observable class is selected.
